Ruling: batch #193 item 5 · letter C · maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-09-20T09:43Z

Director seat, summon #25, `session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **C**, taken directly without a D interim; the maintainer agreed 「其他同意」. Thread re-read (no comments) in the act that wrote this.

## Ruling — **C**: one language per user, and the server holds it

For a signed-in user, `sys_user.locale` is the **single source of truth** for language. The globe icon **writes** `sys_user.locale` when signed in (before sign-in it stays device-only); the i18n provider **seeds** from the server value first, with the device value only as the pre-sign-in fallback and as a cache; the profile page's language option and the globe are the same setting seen from two places. ⛔ **A refused** (keeps the silent divergence and a permanent explanation), ⛔ **B refused** (a device-level illusion), ⛔ **D refused, also as an interim**: a rename that C would undo is the two-step 「渐进」 this project does not do.

Four-facet reading (this seat's own): ① a user profile carries one language and every device and every notification follows it — Salesforce `User.LanguageLocaleKey`, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace per-user language; ② the pull is new (the option did not exist yesterday), so C is its own card rather than a rider on objectui#7501; ③ two same-named settings silently diverging is the worst shape for a user and for an AI agent reading two locale sources; one truth ends it; ④ C removes a concept, D fixes two, B adds a coupling.

`Prior rulings read:` objectstack#14787 (the column made writable), ADR-0030 (locale selects templates; does not rule precedence), thread: none.

## Execution, same stroke

One objectui card, filed in this act as **objectstack-ai/objectui#10059**, carries **both halves in one PR** — the provider's seed precedence (`packages/i18n`) and the globe writing the server (`packages/app-shell`) — because landing either half alone leaves a transitional half-state (a globe that writes a value the UI does not read, or a UI that follows a value the globe cannot change). Serial after objectui#9954 (in flight on `packages/app-shell`). The profile-page copy from objectui#7501's PR is untouched; the `sys_user.locale` write path that PR added is reused. A failed server write is reported loudly and the local switch stands until the next successful read — ⛔ never silent. `Clause-②` declared from the diff (a behaviour change on the published app-shell ⇒ expected `yes`). This card closes `completed`; triage grades the new card.
